manifest.scope: Shared host; zero-delay 6D f(x)=x[0]. Eight sampler physical cores and fifteen database/server cores, disjoint from evaluator cores. One fresh run per measurement; two repeated blocks in reversed order; 16 registered evaluators; a fresh deployment per payload mode or failed cleanup. Fixed batch/queue settings from sparse frontier, not retuned per thread count.
manifest.rate_source: sampler accepted-sample delta / sampler monotonic telemetry interval

validity: Production frontier warmup and accepted-sample telemetry denominator. Fresh run per point; only valid, adequately sampled intervals with successful cleanup plotted. Two short intervals show repeatability, not confidence bounds. Training transports feedback with no optimizer barriers.
